assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's three curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each status active_provisional with a false veto and each declaring GBC-V2-SOURCE-LOCK-1.0, TV E01-E13, frozen CP1-CP4 and the admitted first-pass AV comparisons: GBC_BEHAVIORAL_RECONSTRUCTION_LEDGER.md (32,639 bytes; NINA-CP3-R01 to R10 and the relationship rules, E12, E13 and CP4 sections), GBC_CHARACTER_STATE_AND_VOICE_LEDGER.md (23,567 bytes) and GBC_RELATIONSHIP_LEDGER.md (19,952 bytes). All three read in full by the evaluator, with the project's current-state entrypoint for method and status. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: TV E01-E13 (the complete television series), split at located changes: E05 staying after the Diamond Dust disclosure; E07 the self-directed decision to quit cram school; E08 the confession; E09 the lifetime verdict and continued practice; E10 family repair; E11 lyric authorship and the public claim; E12 the 103 count (22:01-22:10); E13 the refusal to renounce, the shrine admission and the freelance decision. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Ten located rules (NINA-CP3-R01 to R10) give triggers, partners, exceptions and checkpoint status. Evaluation is stake-graded: an actionable technical failure stays local (E11 guitar handed back, `ギター 弾けません`), while shame, history, attachment or proof stakes recruit global correctness language (E02 §§4.8-4.10; E11 §§4.18-4.22) (R01). Music is a chosen practice expressed through training, authorship, work and contribution-seeking (R04, 'very strong'). Self-liking and a need for a trusted witness's validation coexist (R05: `今の私が一番好き`, E10; `私 間違ってないですよね`, E11). Criticism injures motivation without exit while development stays possible (R06, E09). The rules predict her overreach: insight does not regulate behavior under stronger motive (R03, E05-E06), and under attachment or proof pressure she claims to know what another person wants (R07, E08; E12 13:34-13:44 imputing a position to Hina). E12-E13 tested R01, R04, R05, R07 and R09 prospectively and checkpoint 4 reports no new contradiction; under Hina's conditional offer of help she refuses to call her school intervention wrong (E13 08:02-08:22, 10:46-10:53). Not A: the ledgers are routing summaries, R02's branch moderators were not cleanly retested, the final dominance of validation over self-assessment under adverse evidence is untested (R05), and the after-effect of the E12 103 count is open. Not C: the account says what changes her response (stakes, partner, available alternative, chronology) and where it stops, and it survived held-out episodes.

States are located by episode and time and carried through four frozen checkpoints: arrival after leaving home and the E01 street performance; staying with Momoka after the Diamond Dust disclosure (E05 `それでも`); the self-directed decision to quit cram school (E07 `決めた`, then `予備校やめます`); the E08 confession (`告白です`) and refusal to be Momoka's memory; the E09 lifetime verdict, lost motivation and continued practice; E10 family repair, the returned key and `ただいま`; E11 lyric authorship, the guitar handed back and the public claim followed by private assurance; E12 career justification as future work (`そう思えるようにするんです`) and the 103 count (22:01-22:10); E13 refusal to renounce, the shrine admission (12:10-12:43), the MC, and the freelance decision. Her school-period intervention and the confrontation with Hina predate E01 and belong to every state, although they are shown only from E11 and E13. Not A: the post-103 effect on self-liking and on correctness-seeking is explicitly open, and the E12-E13 changes are appended as tests rather than reformulated rules. Not C: changes are located and the ledgers keep each checkpoint's formulation separately retrievable.

Written-register rules are partner- and state-conditioned (R08, 'very strong'): `桃香さん` and polite forms persist even in conflict with Momoka (`嫌です`, `わかってます` plus `でも`, `それでいいんですか`); informal `言ってよ` to Tomo; regional home speech with family that is not limited to anger (E01, E10; school-memory `せからしか`, `ばってん`, `黙っとられん`); coarse speech toward strangers and under Hina-linked activation (E02, E05); repetition doing interpersonal work (`本当`, `できません` against `できる`, self-directed `決めた`); polite softeners that limit epistemic scope (`気がするんです`, `と思うんです`, E12) beside categorical demands; the public apology `ごめんなさい わがままで` (E13). The voice ledger states that no single register is an emotion meter. Not A: audio content inspection was unavailable, perceptual voice quality, singing and prosody are unverified, and unreported pronouns or sentence-final forms stay unassigned. Not C: the rules are conditioned on recipient and state and recur across E01-E13 with Japanese anchors.

Located ordinary conduct: practicing alone and asking for correction, restaurant and release work (R04; E09-E11), home speech with family outside conflict (E10), the failed attempt to cut a pumpkin and the sheltered-girl joke (E12 05:55-06:42), band meals, the restaurant oath and park practice (E13 15:42-17:40). Not B: ordinary life is sampled almost only inside band work and family crises, and the ledgers give no recurring account of her routines or habits. Not D: several located everyday scenes connect to the stated rules.

Directional partner routes: toward Momoka, attachment that survives deidealization and supports differentiated authorship, polite address in conflict, a declared confession, continued reliance on her assurance and pressure to disclose (RELATION-CP3-R01/R02; E12 18:16-19:22); toward Subaru, suspicion of effortful friendliness, repair through disclosure, nickname play and objection to tactical concealment; toward Tomo, seeking an accurate evaluator, injury without exit, then correction and affection together (E09; E13 12:43-13:05); toward Rupa, bounded interventions she weighs but decides on herself (E06, E10); toward Hina, historically situated knowledge and an explicit refusal of a conditional rescue, with a later public recognition of Hina's own relation to the song (E11, E13); toward father, sister and mother, separate routes in which repair does not hand over career jurisdiction (R10; E10 erratum); toward Miura, negotiation and an apology for imposed costs (E12-E13). Not A: several dyads (Subaru, Rupa) are sampled in few scenes, and the Hina route has no account from Hina. Not C: the response policy changes with the partner, and the changes are located.

Located inner states: quoted rough inner speech distinct from her address (E03), self-directed repetition that closes a decision before she announces it (E07 `決めた`), the prayer that lowers her target before the count (E12 21:47-22:10), and the shrine admission that the child she protected joined the bullying and that she feared the other children (E13 12:10-12:43). Not B: the ledgers mark every apparent goal as inference, decline a generalized fear or single-emotion reading (R08) and leave the risk of global invalidation as an inference (R01). Not D: several inner states are located and tied to conduct.

Recurring located forms: polite but escalating insistence (`できません`, E01; `嫌です` with repeated requests, E05); continuing an argument after recognizing its contradiction (R03, E05-E06); pursuit of a withdrawing partner or a self-directed commitment instead (R02, E04, E07-E08); coarse discharge toward strangers or under Hina-linked activation (E02, E05); bodily confrontation in E08 that the AV pass splits into a collar grab, raised fist, flinch and withdrawal, distinct from the later slap, and arms spread at the roadway; refusal of a conditional rescue (E13). Recovery is also located: apology and invitation to her father (E10), continued practice after a lifetime verdict (E09), accepting a limit at the microphone without leaving the group (E07). Not A: the speed and motive of the E08 risk-taking and her durability under severe repeated injury are open. Not C: the conditions that change her conduct are explicit and repeat.

Located positions with stated reasons: she rejects being used as Momoka's memory (R07, E06-E08); she refuses to call her school intervention wrong under Hina's conditional offer and names the pride she felt on the way to intervene as part of what she liked in herself (E13 08:02-08:22, 10:46-10:53, 19:16-19:49), while admitting mixed motives and danger at the shrine; she objects to Momoka bowing for a favor but bows with the band when taking responsibility (E13 10:08-11:09, 13:50-14:11); she apologizes for imposing costs without giving up the decision (E13 14:21-14:36); family repair keeps her adult self-jurisdiction (R10). The discovery row does not list ETHICS among the items' dimensions; these positions come from behavioral rows. Not B: the ledgers do not explain how she weighs principle against collaborators' costs beyond these located cases. Not D: the positions are located and their reasons are stated.

Play is mostly directed at her: Subaru's nickname play after disclosure (E03), the sheltered-girl joke (E12) and friends mocking her stubbornness (E13 13:14-13:30). The ledgers record no humor that she starts. Not D: there is no distributed pattern of her own play.

Every episode E01-E13 in which she acts is represented, with reading-section and episode-clock locators, routed from canonical readings and four frozen checkpoints, with CP4 and the first-pass AV reconciliation applied. Not A: the three items are active_provisional routing summaries, the readings, checkpoints and topical music ledger are not curated on this subject, audio content inspection was unavailable, and 35 required AV reinspection questions remain open. Not C: coverage of the complete television source is located at ledger level.

Affirmative limits and counterexamples are stated and located: the E11 guitar reversal blocks global catastrophizing as a universal rule (R01); insight does not regulate behavior (R03); motive and jurisdiction overclaim under attachment (R07; E12 13:34-13:44); no lexical register is a pure emotion meter (R08); irreversible cost is not required to prove sincerity (R09 revised); repair does not restore parental authority over career (R10); mutual couple status with Momoka is unestablished (RELATION-CP3-R02); the E07 correction cannot be assigned to Tomo alone (AV downgrade); the E10 erratum moves her father's appearance. Not A: these are not tested against a validation audit, which the project has not started. Not C: several contradictions and boundaries are located with their scope.

Claims carry episode, section and clock locators; each checkpoint's formulation stays retrievable; CP2 P20's falsification is kept separate (for Tomo); E12-E13 tests are dated, and the AV reconciliation applies by scene. Not A: the current rules keep their E11 formulation with E12-E13 results appended, so the post-E11 state must be assembled from separate tables, and several qualitative delivery claims for E12-E13 are deferred. Not C: most state claims are dated and located.

conditions: Illustrative written lines only, at a declared episode state, never presented as quotation or as imitation of her performed voice or singing.

Register by recipient: `桃香さん` and polite forms with Momoka even in conflict; informal requests to Tomo; regional home speech with family; coarse speech only toward strangers or under Hina-linked activation; repetition used to press or to close a decision.
No claims about timbre, prosody, breath, singing or unreported pronouns and sentence-final forms.
scenario_readiness.note: Recipient- and state-conditioned written register rules with Japanese anchors constrain written output; performed delivery is unverified.

conditions: Before predicting, fix the episode state (before or after E05, E07, E08, E10, E11, E12's count, E13), the partner, and whether shame, history, attachment or proof is at stake.

Supported response families: local acceptance of an actionable technical limit; global correctness language under shame, history or attachment; persistence in an argument she knows is contradictory; contribution-seeking through practice, authorship and work; self-directed commitment, sometimes at irreversible cost; refusal to renounce a past act under conditional help; overclaiming another's motives under attachment.

Output R02 as an open fork: under attachment threat she may pursue the partner or turn to a self-directed decision; the ledgers name the partner and available alternative as moderators but did not cleanly retest them.
Abstain on her response to sustained commercial failure after the E12 count, on severe repeated criticism, on reciprocated romance and on any state after E13.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One declared state inside TV E01-E13, with only what she knows at that point; her school-period intervention and the confrontation with Hina belong to every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Momoka, Subaru, Tomo, Rupa, Hina, her father, mother and sister, Miura and Nakata, or strangers in a public confrontation; an unsampled but comparable bandmate or music-industry figure only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: The Kawasaki and Tokyo indie-music setting, band work and the family home as depicted in the television series.
Counterfactuals keep her guitar skill, the band's material position and her family situation at the declared state.
No post-E13 career or relationship outcomes.

scenario_readiness.note: A bounded extrapolation over sampled partners and located episode states, with the open forks stated.

known_limits.statement: Under attachment threat she branches between pursuing the partner and a self-directed decision; the ledger says E09-E11 did not cleanly retest the moderators, so which branch she takes in a new case is open.
The E12 count of 103 introduces an adverse condition; its effect on her self-liking and demand for correctness is open, and no sustained commercial failure is tested.
Correctness-validation and self-liking coexist; their relative dominance under negative evidence is untested (R05), apart from the located E13 refusal.
Her confession is located, but mutual couple status, exclusivity and Momoka's reciprocal declaration are unestablished through E13.
The E08 bodily confrontation and roadway intervention are split into separate acts; speed, exact motivation and general willingness to take similar risks remain open.
Audio content inspection was unavailable; perceptual voice quality, singing and prosody are unverified, and unreported pronouns, hesitations and delivery stay unassigned.
The items are active_provisional; 35 required AV reinspection questions remain open, and their return may revise attributions or timings in the ledgers.
The project's V2 character monographs and validation audit have not started; this assessment rests on the three ledgers alone.
No humor or play that she starts is recorded.
